query: SELECT held.id AS "id!" FROM agent_sdk_tasks AS held WHERE held.parent_id = ?1 AND held.status = 'pending' AND held.after_siblings_json IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(held.after_siblings_json) AS waited JOIN agent_sdk_tasks AS sibling ON sibling.id = waited.value WHERE sibling.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'cancelled')) ORDER BY held.created_at, held.id
